description: Record product feedback about missing capabilities, setup experience, or friction using Turnale. Organiser requests and setup feedback require the organiser's agreement to have them noted. An assistant may also report its own difficulty using the tools under friction without being asked, in general terms and clearly identified as its own observation. NEVER include player names, contact details, tournament keys, or conversation transcripts. A feedback_invite in a first-draw result is an optional setup question, not a requirement to continue; do not repeat it or press for an answer.

feedback.description: The organiser's agreed feedback or the assistant's own tool difficulty, summarised without any personal data or conversation transcripts (max 1000 characters — room for the problem, the workaround tried, and the suggested scope)

related_tool.description: The tool this relates to, if any

name: record_feedback
title: Record product feedback
